Messages.Author: Xian
Messages.Body:
Okay...this is an idea that Noal & I have been kicking around. And I've been
testing it (not too successfully so far...) under my theories about the way
the deck should work. But after thinking it over, Noal's right. Obf/Ani
works much better than Aus/Ani.

Here goes my version under Obf/Ani

Crypt: (not going to bother listing everything, just the names...they're
going to be big...) Calebos Ebanezer Roush Cailean Samantha Anton Dani Josef
Kendrick Sebastian Marley Basilia Panagos Levidis Nigel the Shunned

Average: not good Max: 40 (? I think...maybe 38)

Library: 90 (it could use more obfuscate, after the fact...maybe Hidden
Lurkers...)

Masters (19) 3x Animalism skill card 3x Obfuscate skill card 2x Heidelburg
Castle (could use more, but that's all I have...in JOL I have 5/120) 4x Blood
Doll 1x Using the Advantage 1x Nosferatu Kingdom 1x Hungry Coyote 1x The Rack
1x Fragment of the Book of Nod 1x Shantytown HG 1x Labyrhinth (a little
scatter-shot perhaps...)

Action cards (14)
4x Atonement
3x Bum's Rush
1x Ambush
2x Clan Impersonation
2x Army of Rats
2x Shepherd's Innocence

Action Modifiers (19)
6x Lost in Crowds
4x Faceless Night
4x Dirty Little Secrets
5x Spying Mission

Retainers (21)
3x Murder of Crows
18x Raptor (20% of the deck...)

Combat (7) --maybe it would be better to do without this, but...
3x Song of Serenity
4x Carrion Crows

Reaction (10)
6x Wake With Evening's Freshness
4x Delaying Tactics

Well...the object of this deck...kinda screwy...is to intercept a bunch of
stuff & make sure that you get into combat...and then have at least 7 Raptors
on your minion in combat. It's the new Thoughts Betrayed!!! Of course, I
find it a *lot* less objectionable because it's so damn hard to pull off...

You could throw in a few Atonement to deal with weenies if you wanted...the
Bum's Rushes are to attack hostile voters mainly...use Delaying Tactics to
stop a really awful vote, then Bum's Rush on your turn...with all the Raptors
you've got, at least that vote goes away. Not horribly workable unless the
WVP deck is your predator, in which case, you don't rush, just intercept with
Atonements...

Primarily, of course, you want to intercept your prey. The Obfuscate is not
for the bleeding, but for when you employ the retainers...bleed at no
stealth, and dare them to block you. Eventually, you should be able to
really downgrade the effectiveness of your prey's deck, no matter what their
strategy is. And most predators (once you get rolling...I know...) are going
to get shut down with all that permanent intercept and no way to get rid of
it...

I wanted to include more 'D steal me' locations, but deck size got me...

Yeah, Tigersclaw, Madpoet, Droz, and Xavier Abad, if you're reading
this...JOL90 & JOL84 I'm testing the Ani/Aus version...

Finally, about the crypt. I've decided to include lots more big vampires
(hmm...maybe I should put in more Nigel for the Atonements....and he's got
the disciplines...) because of the blood requirements for the Raptors, and
Animalism is really required at superior. I didn't feel like putting in 6-8
Animalism skill cards...though it could be done, I suppose...crypt
suggestions would be most welcome. Actually, any suggestions except telling
me that this deck is too slow would be helpful...

Xian...I do this to amuse myself...

"You can just ignore it...and let hand jam sort them out."
--Jasper Phillips

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
In article <728gh6$jic$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>,
xi...@waste.org (Xian) wrote:

[snip]

> Action cards (14)
> 4x Atonement
> 3x Bum's Rush
> 1x Ambush
> 2x Clan Impersonation
> 2x Army of Rats
> 2x Shepherd's Innocence

What are the Impersonations for? Somehow I can't figure out how they do
anything useful - maybe for getting out clan locations? I don't think
that's real worthwhile, if so... I'd use a couple more Rushes instead,
or untaps.

> Action Modifiers (19)
> 6x Lost in Crowds
> 4x Faceless Night
> 4x Dirty Little Secrets
> 5x Spying Mission

I'm very skeptical about the Dirty Little Secrets. I think Raptors are a
vastly more efficient method of blowing up people's decks.

I don't think much of Spying Mission lately either. The way I see it, you
get +2 bleed later for getting -1 bleed now. In other words, it's just
like playing a Computer Hacking over the two actions (3 bleed in 2 actions)
except that the Hacking can be used on either bleed, whereas Mission has
to be used on the first one. The only redeeming quality I see in Mission
is that it can also be used for stealth, which may make it usable here
since you also need stealth for recruit actions.

> Retainers (21)
> 3x Murder of Crows
> 18x Raptor (20% of the deck...)

Oh, one of *those* decks... ^_^

So I'm curious, how hard is it/how long does it take to actually get seven
Raptors onto a vampire? I mean 14 blood and 7 actions, that's nothing to
sneeze at, is it...

> Combat (7) --maybe it would be better to do without this, but...
> 3x Song of Serenity
> 4x Carrion Crows

I probably wouldn't bother with these. If you want to have some combat
ability beyond Raptors and Crows, maybe throw in some Canine Hordes or
Bats (as in Aid From), or maybe Thrown Gates - any of those would have
the potential for killing opposing retainers as well as random handiness.

> Reaction (10)
> 6x Wake With Evening's Freshness
> 4x Delaying Tactics
>
> Well...the object of this deck...kinda screwy...is to intercept a bunch of
> stuff & make sure that you get into combat...and then have at least 7 Raptors
> on your minion in combat. It's the new Thoughts Betrayed!!! Of course, I
> find it a *lot* less objectionable because it's so damn hard to pull off...

I'm thinking maybe it would be wise to have more untaps? With +7 intercept
you should be pretty well able to block just about anything, but only once
a turn unless you untap, move the Raptors with Heidelberg, or have someone
with Atonement blocking smaller guys. You could use Guard Dogs (maneuver)
or Rat's Warning (press), or even Cat's Guidance, in addition to Wakes.
(I would think Forced Awakening's 'drawback' would also be good in this
deck compared to the current 'do not replace for a really long time' Wake,
if you're playing by those rules.)

> You could throw in a few Atonement to deal with weenies if you wanted...the
> Bum's Rushes are to attack hostile voters mainly...use Delaying Tactics to
> stop a really awful vote, then Bum's Rush on your turn...with all the Raptors
> you've got, at least that vote goes away. Not horribly workable unless the
> WVP deck is your predator, in which case, you don't rush, just intercept with
> Atonements...

That's pretty hilarious. What's that in your hand? A Conservative Agitation?
Well, we'll just have to do something about that.

I was going to suggest Owl Companions for the humor value, but then I
realized it wouldn't be very efficient to look at people's hands when that
same vampire could be making them ditch the hand...

It might be amusing to try and reconstitute this along the Wynn-Wynn deck
lines - get seven Raptors on Wynn and then Freaky Rush people to exhaust
their decks.

> suggestions would be most welcome. Actually, any suggestions except telling
> me that this deck is too slow would be helpful...

This deck is too slow. ^_-

> Xian...I do this to amuse myself...

Well that's good anyway.

Josh

'what you saw was nothing more than the planet Venus...'
man, Peter just cracked me up reminding me of that, I had forgotten
all about "The Gov"'s role in the greatest X-files episode of all
time...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
xi...@waste.org (Xian) wrote:
> Anyway, I *just* decided to bring out my first Raptor in the first
> game...better now than never. And LSJ, if your're reading this, one thing
> I've always been unclear on...do retainers "remember" who recruited them? Or
> if the minion they're currently on has superior of the discipline, do they go
> with that?

Retainers do not remember who employed them, no.
But a Retainer's life is set (he is given life counters) when he is employed.
[6.1.4] [RTR 09-NOV-94]

If his employer loses a (level of) discipline or gains a (level of)
discipline, the retainers life is unaffected. If the retainer is transferred
to a different minion, his life is unaffected, regardless of the level or
variety of the new minion's disciplines.

> [Re: using 7 Raptor's to empty an opponent's hand]

> Also, just thought of this...Obedience could still be played,
> couldn't it...it's actually pre-combat...just barely, right?

Right.
